source.selection_rule: CoinGecko base-ecosystem tokens with a Base contract, excluding stablecoins and wrapped majors, market cap 10M..600M and 24h volume above 1M, then any token whose hourly transfer volume is bridge-scale is dropped as unreplayable.
source.survivorship_note: the universe was picked because these tokens are actively traded NOW, so it is selected on survival; forward holder growth is measured inside that same window
source.sell_pressure_note: v3 sell pressure is an exit rate (exits / prev holders), not value-to-LP as in v1
